The '''''Consular''-class light cruiser''' or '''''Consular''-class cruiser''', commonly referred to as '''Republic cruiser''', was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to troubled spots across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RadiantVII_ep1ig.png|thumb|left|250px|''Consular''-class cruiser schematics.]]
The ''Consular''-class space cruiser was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed and manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and diplomats to troubled spots across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EPI:ICS" /><ref name="TPM" /> Civilian models of the ''Consular''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] were used for straight-forward transportation and were indistinct. Craft of the ''Consular''-class in diplomatic service were painted red to declare their diplomatic immunity and to also serve as a warning not to attack. Red was the color of [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadorial]] relations and neutrality for [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] of the Republic and had been so for many centuries. During the Clone Wars, these cruisers were painted the same colors as Republic attack cruisers. Any ship hailing from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] would be painted entirely red; others would only have stripes.<ref name="EPI:ICS" />

The Republic cruiser was equipped with a [[Salon pod/Legends|salon pod]] that served as a secure meeting area for Republic representatives and leaders of groups in conflict. There was also a variety of salon pods that catered to different [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species.<ref name="EPI:ICS" />
In emergency situations, the entire salon pod could eject from the mother craft, and with its own [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[Life support/Legends|life support equipment]], and engines, protect the diplomatic crew on board. The craft also carried a number of [[Consular escape pod|escape pods]].<ref name="EPI:ICS" />

The cruiser's total capacity was 9 crew and 16 passengers. For increased security on diplomatic missions, the organic crew was kept to a minimum, with many ship functions attended to by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="EPI:ICS" />

Although the diplomatic versions were unarmed, various cruisers were modified to have double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons and two [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers installed and to serve in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] and regional security forces, at least some of which were then re-designated as either [[Republic light assault cruiser]]s<ref name="SOTGSE" /> or [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|Republic frigates]].<ref name="TCW:TVG" /> Others were modified to serve as troop [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] and [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]].<ref name="SOTGSE" />

==History==
Consular cruisers entered service late in the time period of the Republic. An early version of the ship was built after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and was put into service by [[990 BBY]].<ref name="Rule of Two" /> They were created due to budget cuts that required the building of new utilitarian and unostentatious starships; it was that quality of them that attracted the Jedi to their use.<ref name="Rule of Two" /> Later ''Consulars'' would continue to serve the Jedi and the Republic many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later.<ref name="TPM" />

During the prelude to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> it was a ''Consular''-class cruiser, [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']], that transported [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] orbiting [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During this mission, the ship had a crew of one [[Antidar Williams/Legends|pilot]] and a [[Maoi Madakor/Legends|captain]], though both died when the Trade Federation destroyed the vessel.<ref name="TPM" />

Militarized ''Consular''-classes known as [[Republic light assault cruiser]]s served the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] and the [[Yinchorri Uprising]]. Those vessels had cannons and extra armor added to their design.<ref name="SOTGSE" />

[[File:Republic_Frigate.png|thumb|left|225px|A Republic cruiser adapted into a Republic frigate during the Clone Wars.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some ''Consular''-class ships went through the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|Charger c70 retrofit]], having weapon batteries added and serving as small [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] in the Republic wartime Navy.<ref name="A">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> They possessed a combination of firepower and speed that made them valuable components of the Navy.<ref name="TCW:TVG" />

Civilians such as [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] also used ''Consulars.'' One of his [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighters]] was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]].<ref name="SA" />

The militarized ''Consular''-class frigates had a paint job similar to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="A" />
The tradition of painting strictly diplomatic vessels red continued even into the days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] vessel, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], was striped in red to indicate diplomatic immunity.<ref name="EPI:ICS" />

A handful of armed cruisers were still in operation throughout the galaxy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The smuggler [[Rif Taranu]] aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by using his modified cruiser ''[[Dead Reckoning]]'' to transport goods for them.<ref name="SOTG01" /> Several were seen at the [[Jubilee Wheel (space station)|Jubilee Wheel]] early in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and participated in the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|Battle of Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="AOCI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The early designs of the ''Consular''-class cruiser had a smooth, "[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]-look" to it. After several iterations, [[George Lucas]] and [[Doug Chiang]] decided that the cruiser should have a strong visual link to the [[original trilogy]]. With that direction, Chiang and the Art Department devised a ship with a more rectilinear profile that echoed the design of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''s]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|''blockade runner'']]. One of the last additions to the cruiser was the small antenna array that rests above the cockpit. Lucas felt that the ship needed "a little extra something" to guide the audience's eyes to that section of the ship.

In [[Empire 22|''Empire'' 22]] the Consular cruiser was mistakenly drawn like a [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]].

In a [[2007]] campaign for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s version of the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'', the pirate ship ''[[Blood Brother]]''<ref name="EOTJ" /> from the [[1986]] story [[Droids (1986) 3|''The Scarlet Pirate'']], the third issue of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] series of comics,<ref name="SWD3">[[Droids (1986) 3|''Droids'' (1986) 3]]</ref> was identified as a ''Consular''-class cruiser.<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> However, the vessel's appearance differed significantly<ref name="SWD3" /> from a ''Consular''-class cruiser seen in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> To resolve that discrepancy,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50806562|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-04-11|time=1:15 PM|archivedate=20180316143733}}</ref> the class to which the ''Blood Brother'' belonged was later renamed ''Consular III'' by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] in the first part of "[[The Droids Re-Animated]]," a pair of reference articles at the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]].<ref name="tdr-a">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
